items.summary: Pre-existing upstream barney GPU fault (NOT a ROCm/HIP port defect): the 'cone' geometry intersect faults identically on BOTH the software (cuBQL) backend and the HIPRT backend on gfx90a, even at 1 primitive; device intersect code is byte-identical to upstream NVIDIA barney (the port changes only runtime spellings, not the cone math). Capsules and N>=8 cylinders also fault on the cuBQL software backend only (a separate pre-existing cuBQL two-level traversal issue) while the HIPRT backend renders them correctly. Cannot confirm on stock CUDA barney here (host has no NVIDIA GPU). The Backend-2 HIPRT count-scaling intersect-thunk corruption was the porter's bug and is FIXED (cylinders/capsules render, pixel-identical to B1 where B1 works). Scope: file upstream against NVIDIA/barney once an NVIDIA GPU is available to confirm; not blocking the ROCm port.
Re-pin submodules/cuBQL to NVIDIA/cuBQL after NVIDIA/cuBQL#35 merges

Rescan with the fixed scan_nvidia: vendored OptiX headers in submodules/optix/include (8 files) and submodules/owl/3rdParty/optix (7 files) carry the NVIDIA proprietary 'licensors retain' notice, contradicting the intake note 'NO NVIDIA Source Code License ... anywhere' -- the screen likely ran without submodules initialized. Licence verdict needs re-ruling with the submodules in view.
